rationale: Several direct candidates propose different mechanisms to address the Hubble tension, such as thermal vacuum cosmology (2602.08522), late-time dynamical dark energy (2607.29562), gravitational particle production (2402.16791), early dark energy (2410.10559), Horndeski gravity (2301.09382), and new physics in the CMB damping tail (2503.20002). These papers contribute substantive new evidence but do not converge on a single resolution, leaving the question partially addressed.
